author: StewieFG
body:
Hello, 

I've seen something and I discussed that with timaeusTestified already, I'll just tell you what I think.
Map developers are the most experienced people with making maps, YMLs, and everything about maps. They are map developers from the simple reason they are better from others in making maps, no offense, and they have great building skills with aesthetics, gameplay and creativity. When map developers send maps to the contest, they look the best and it's fairly hard to win them because the are really efficient and work very fast, which make them release the maximum number of maps, which also really increases their chances to win. A great example is Pavlo, a really good map maker which makes maps really fast and his maps in the current and pasts contest are very hard to win. My concern isn't that it's biased and map developers win, it's just that they are so good that it's nearly impossible to win. 2 solutions that I've found:

1. Make map developers not participate in the contest
2. If the maximum number of maps you can send is 4, mapdevs will be able to send only 1 or 2 maps.

These will increase the chances of players to win contests, some players don't participate because they see maps of map developers and usually the reaction is "holy shit. There is no way to win that, no point if participating.". 

Opinions??

title: Map developers in contests

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body: mmm, in the previous contest I kinda felt the same way (I wasn't a mapdev until the contest was over), with other mapdevs being able to submit maps. Although I feel map developers should still have a chance to get a prize, because otherwise it would sort of be excluding them. I'm not sure how to solve this though....maybe if 1st place is gained by a mapdev, then have 2nd place receive the same prize?

replies.body: I think each map developer will be able to send only 1 map to every contest. Of course everybody gets a prize no matter whom the first place.

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body: I have no issue with map developers submitting a map, but I see where you're coming from with those points. I would be happy to restrict it to a single submission if that's what people think is fair.

replies.body: I think they should be able to participate, because even if they are Map Devs they still want to send in any maps they create ! :D

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
imo with any contest you're gonna face a lot of competition, the mapdevs arent the only amazing map makers, and to be honest maybe not all mapdevs are great map makers (?)
another option is that everyone is only allowed to submit one map. that is the best option imo, because the only advantage that a mapdev really has is working very efficiently, having a history with making maps in general. it would also add more pressure to the contest, you'd have to make your map the best it could be. mapdevs may be good at making maps, but i dont think this "advantage" is limited to them, and just because they have the rank doesnt mean they shouldnt be able to contribute.
just my onion
